name: m5-names-paired
description: A quick look at the `-Yname-table` stores, interleaved in one JVM with a class loader per variant, so each store's call sites stay monomorphic. Twelve cycles of six variants, with a balanced order. One fork per corpus: this ranks the stores and is not a precise measure.

variantDescriptions.aa: `chars` again in another class loader, for the noise floor
variantDescriptions.chars: [retronym/scala#204](https://github.com/retronym/scala/pull/204) at `b43cf4e985`, `-Yname-table:chars`, the baseline here. The cost of `NameStore` against plain upstream is in `m4-names-ab`.
variantDescriptions.shared: `-Yname-table:shared`. A full GC between iterations clears its weak table, so this shows no reuse across compiles
